cards.name: Fists of Flame
cards.oracleText: Draw a card. Until end of turn, target creature gains trample and gets +1/+0 for each card you've drawn this turn. (A creature with trample can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)

cards.name: Fist of Suns
cards.oracleText: You may pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} rather than pay the mana cost for spells you cast.

cards.name: Fists of Ironwood
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, create two 1/1 green Saproling creature tokens.
Enchanted creature has trample.

cards.name: Fists of the Anvil
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +4/+0 until end of turn.

cards.name: Fists of the Demigod
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
As long as enchanted creature is black, it gets +1/+1 and has wither. (It deals damage to creatures in the form of -1/-1 counters.)
As long as enchanted creature is red, it gets +1/+1 and has first strike.

cards.name: Fistful of Force
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn. Clash with an opponent. If you win, that creature gets an additional +2/+2 and gains trample until end of turn. (Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts that card on their choice of the top or bottom. A player wins if their card had a greater mana value.)
